prompt: 2-methylpropene (isobutylene) + HBr (no peroxides). Draw the alkyl bromide product.

traps.note: Markovnikov: Br on the MORE substituted carbon (makes the more stable 3° cation).

explanation: Protonation gives the more stable tertiary carbocation; Br⁻ attacks there → tert-butyl bromide. Without peroxides, HBr always adds Markovnikov.
